name: TieredPricingEditor
tagline: The Tiered Pricing Editor turns one text column into a price-break table.
description: The Tiered Pricing Editor turns one text column into a price-break table. Each tier covers a band of quantities - for example 1-9, 10-49, 50-199 and 200 or more - and has its own unit price or a discount off the list price. The bands always follow on from each other, so there can be no gaps or overlaps.
features: Unit price or discount %, tier names, split/remove
A unit-price chart and a price check calculator (volume or graduated pricing) with savings vs list
